dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: You want a fortune slip?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Geez, she's so cold.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, I'd like one...

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Got it. Here's how it goes. First, shake this... thing over here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Isn't it called a Fortune Slip Box?

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Yes. A Bamboo Slip will drop out from it. Give it to me, and I'll give you a matching strip of paper.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm pretty sure they say it's a Fortune Slip...

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Whatever.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's got a question! If... What do we do if we get one that means bad luck?

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: It's fate. You got a problem with that? Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Isn't there that shelf-like thing outside we can use to...

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Tsk.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did she seriously just say "tsk"?

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Let me see... Oh right, so it's like this. "Tie the inauspicious slip onto the Fortune Slip Hanger to change ill fortune to good"...

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Ah, right! If you get a slip with ill fortune, just tie it to that shelf, that'll do.

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Huh, what a bunch of... No, sorry. We at the Grand Narukami Shrine are most gentle indeed. Even if you should draw a slip with bad luck, you shall have a chance to turn it around.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Something about this doesn't seem right...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Let's go draw a slip, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Give me that bamboo slip.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: R—Right.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This shrine really seems to lack the whole divine affection thing, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's see how our luck's going...

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Ah, yes. You can only draw one fortune slip each day. Please remember that.

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: It's too tiring otherwise... Wait, no. If not, you won't be able to use the Fortune Slip Hanger to... No, that's not right either. What was I supposed to say?

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: "Fortune slips are the manifestation of our archon's will. It is our place as mortals to respect it and do all we can."

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: See? Elegantly put. So please remember, you can only draw one fortune slip each day.

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ms. Gendou's attitude is the same as ever, huh... Anyway, let's check the slip's contents.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? This is...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, Paimon gets it. This must refer to some bad guy who needs defeating!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, that's gotta be it. So, Ms. Gendou, you're a secret agent who's using this method to communicate and wipe out those who try to harm Inazuma, right?

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: You talk too much.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Welp! S-sorry! Please don't sic the "Shuumatsu" on us!

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Leave now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're leaving right now! Let's go to the place shown in the picture and see if we can find our target!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Hand over the fortune slip) In the middle of a hazy night.

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: "Cloudy."

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Here. Your strip of paper.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Goodbye.
